method: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826) 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer' (published 9 October 2025). Every claim is a paraphrase backed by anchors (scripts/anchor.py): verify.py --source re-finds each anchored span in a fresh copy of the source, checks the claim's numbers against it and rejects copying. LICENCE: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read at NCBI PMC efetch JATS <license> element for PMC12546840 (Europe PMC returned HTTP 503 on 2026-09-23)). The source's words are NOT reproduced here.

claims.claim: **KRAS is mutated in more than 90% of these cancers.** Test somatic KRAS in unresectable disease and germline BRCA in all patients; somatic BRCA testing can be considered. BRCA carriers do better on platinum and may benefit from PARP inhibitors.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **KRAS wild-type tumours can carry other actionable changes** (NTRK, ROS1, ALK, RET), so they warrant wider testing where NGS is limited.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Surgery should remove and examine at least 16 lymph nodes** for adequate staging, with perioperative heparin thromboprophylaxis (unfractionated or LMWH) unless contraindicated.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Drain the biliary tree endoscopically before resection only if bilirubin exceeds 250 μmol/l with cholangitis, or surgery will be delayed beyond 2 weeks.**
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **For resectable tumours, avoid neoadjuvant treatment outside trials:** phase III evidence is too thin.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX for resected patients with ECOG PS 0–1** (median survival 54.4 vs 35.0 months with gemcitabine); S-1 is an Asian alternative. If mFOLFIRINOX is unsuitable, gemcitabine–capecitabine; failing that, gemcitabine or 5-FU–leucovorin alone.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Borderline resectable: induction FOLFIRINOX (or modified) or gemcitabine–nab-paclitaxel, then surgery.** Gemcitabine doublets are options when those are not feasible.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Locally advanced: up to 6 months of combination chemotherapy aiming at conversion surgery** is a valid strategy; surgery is discussed if CA 19-9 falls markedly, the patient improves and the tumour downstages.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **First line with ECOG PS 0–1 and bilirubin under 1.5 times normal: FOLFIRINOX, NALIRIFOX, gemcitabine–nab-paclitaxel or mFOLFIRINOX.** With PS 2, KPS under 70 or higher bilirubin: gemcitabine (or S-1) alone.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Gemcitabine–nab-paclitaxel (MPACT, KPS 70 or more):** response 23% vs 7% and median survival 8.7 vs 6.6 months against gemcitabine. A meta-analysis found overall survival similar to FOLFIRINOX.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **NALIRIFOX beat gemcitabine–nab-paclitaxel on survival (11.1 vs 9.2 months) in the NAPOLI trial;** a network meta-analysis favours NALIRIFOX or FOLFIRINOX when tolerable, with gemcitabine–nab-paclitaxel a sound alternative.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Second line after FOLFIRINOX: gemcitabine alone or with paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel** (PS 0–2). After gemcitabine-based treatment, with PS 0–1: liposomal irinotecan–5-FU–leucovorin or mFOLFIRINOX. Oxaliplatin-based second line is contentious.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Venous thromboembolism affects 20%–25% of patients;** consider primary thromboprophylaxis during chemotherapy for advanced disease if there is no contraindication.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Duodenal obstruction: an endoscopic metal stent, or EUS-guided gastroenterostomy where expertise exists,** rather than surgery.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Regular follow-up after resection is now suggested:** routine imaging was linked to longer survival than symptom-led follow-up (28 vs 23 months) in a prospective study.
claims.locator: European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) with Pan-Asian oncology societies, ESMO Open (doi 10.1016/j.esmoop.2025.105826), 'Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with pancreatic cancer', published 9 October 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12546840/, retrieved 2026-09-23
